data.description:
## Goal
Create plugins/dso/scripts/flag-deprecation-check.sh that inspects a diff/patch for new flag function additions and refuses without a formal deprecation plan document.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/flag-deprecation-check.sh

## Logic
- Read diff from stdin or --diff-file argument
- Detect new is_*_enabled() function additions in planning-config.sh (or any sourced flag library)
- For each new flag addition, look for corresponding docs/flag-deprecation-plans/<flag-name>.md
- Validate plan doc contains: plan_date, owner, replacement_key fields
- On missing plan or invalid plan: exit 1 with structured JSON error; exit 0 when all new flags have valid plans

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/flag-deprecation-check.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-flag-deprecation-check.sh exits 0 (all 4 cases GREEN)

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S7/T2)
